name: Mijos
description: Mijos was a swampy world in the Anoat sector of the Outer Rim Territories and a stopover point for travel between the planets Lutrillia and Gerrenthum on the Lutrillian Cross hyperlane. A number of Lutrillian-run spaceports could be found on Mijos, but poor structural planning had caused many of these settlements to sink into the planet's muck.
